botanical_name normalized from 'Carotte Hybride' ('Carotte' is just French for 'carrot', not a genus - etl.backfill_taxonomy's genus_from_botanical_name correctly declined it as nonsense input) to 'Daucus carota', matching the sibling plants/carrot.json record's own botanical_name convention. Verified 2026-07-19: 'Snow Man' is a real F1 hybrid white carrot cultivar sold by multiple seed companies (Territorial Seed, Stokes Seeds, Wong Sam Hing Seeds, nunhems) as an Imperator-type Daucus carota, confirming the existing companions[] entry pointing at plants/carrot.json was already correct. Genus/family then backfilled normally via etl.backfill_taxonomy.
